title: Stir-Fried Cabbage with Pork Belly and Soybean Paste

ingredients.rawText: Green garlic shoots, stems and leaves separated
ingredients.name: green garlic

ingredients.rawText: Oil, a little for the pan
ingredients.name: oil

ingredients.rawText: Dark soy sauce, a little for color
ingredients.name: dark soy sauce

steps.text: Tear the cabbage into pieces, soak in lightly salted water for 10 minutes, then wash and drain thoroughly.
Cut the pork belly into thick slices, then strips. Slice the green garlic stems and leaves separately; chop the scallion whites and mince the ginger and garlic.
Heat a little oil in a wok. Add the pork belly and stir-fry over low heat for 2–3 minutes to render its fat, then remove the pork.
Stir-fry the cabbage in the pork fat with a little salt until partly cooked and bright in color. Remove and set aside.
Fry the scallion whites, ginger and garlic in the remaining oil. Add the pork belly and green garlic stems, then the soybean paste and a little dark soy sauce. Stir-fry until fragrant.
Return the cabbage and toss until coated. Keep this final stir-fry within 2 minutes; add the green garlic leaves at the end, toss until cooked and serve.

notes: Drain the cabbage thoroughly and keep the final stir-fry brief to retain its crisp texture.
